messages:
Priya (PM): Looming ask from Lina/Sales at Helix Systems — Customer wants private deployment (VPC + on-prem) with dedicated capacity, strict data residency, HSM. They asked for timeline and must-have list by EOD tomorrow. Can we triage?

Lina (Sales): Customer committed to 6-9 month procurement. Big ask: FIPS-140 KMS/HSM + airgap option. Also pricing expectations: predictable monthly reserved capacity. They need onboarding window in Q3.

Connor (Eng): Quick gut: core runtime supports this, but airgapped install + HSM is non-trivial. Need infra work (bootstrap scripts), vetted installer, and KMS integration. Also network egress restrictions will affect model downloads.

Sam (SRE): Ops concerns: monitoring across private installs, log retention, upgrade path, and support SLAs. We need an 'ops agent' + a secure metrics relay. Also cert rotation automation.

Aisha (Solutions): Blockers from pre-sales: demo env that mirrors customer's config (airgapped + HSM). We don't have an example playbook. Suggest we prepare a trimmed checklist: Preflight -> Network -> Secrets -> Image delivery -> Install window -> Smoke tests.

Priya (PM): Proposed triage outcome: 1) Must-haves (HSM/KMS, VPC peering, airgap install scripts) 2) Nice-to-have (local metrics relay, advanced RBAC) 3) Deferred (custom UI). Owners: Connor for eng, Sam for SRE, Aisha for solutions. Agree?

Connor (Eng): Agree. Need effort estimates. Rough: HSM/KMS integration 3w, airgap installer + image signing 4w, peering + networking docs 1w, smoke test harness 1w = ~9w. That's just engineering work; QA + packaging add 2-3w.

Lina (Sales): That's fine to share as initial estimate. Customer will push for faster — can we offer a phased delivery where we deliver VPC + KMS first and airgap later?

Sam (SRE): Phased path is safer. Phase 1: VPC + KMS + reserved capacity + basic observability. Phase 2: Airgap + HSM + hardened upgrade flows.

Priya (PM): Launch criteria for Phase 1 (must be explicit): - Install runbook validated on >=1 partner VM - KMS integration tested with key rotation - SLA docs and rollback playbook - Verified model pinning and versioned images - Security review completed

Connor (Eng): I'll post an initial runbook draft later. Quick note: model pinning requires our artifacts registry to sign artifacts; need to add Docker image signing step. Add to checklist.

Aisha (Solutions): For the customer, we should prepare an FAQ and a preflight checklist. I'll own that. Also propose a 'pilot' with GA constraints (2 months support window) to limit support exposure.

Priya (PM): Next steps: Connor to create an RFC and rough Gantt, Sam to list SRE gaps, Aisha to draft customer-facing preflight + pilot offer. Lina to confirm customer's top 3 blockers. Review sync Friday 10am. Anyone object?

Connor (Eng): No objections.

Sam (SRE): Good.

Lina (Sales): I'll confirm and loop in legal for data residency clauses.

deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-deploy-playbook (stub)

Priya (PM): Thanks all. I'll put owners into the intake ticket and mark priority P1. /cc @exec
